scope: PIPELINE execution only: models are randomly initialized in memory (no checkpoints, no downloads). A PASS shows the JevX extraction and decision path ran end-to-end with every invariant holding; it makes no statement about a checkpoint's accuracy.

exclusions.reason: v5's TrOCRForCausalLM.forward consumes encoder_hidden_states, not pixels (models/trocr/modeling_trocr.py:666-747: the forward forwards input_ids/attention_mask/encoder_hidden_states into self.model.decoder and declares no pixel_values). The vision tower is a SEPARATE model and transformers 5.16.1 ships no TrOCRModel base to wrap, so a single JevX state -> representation call does not exist. Its own docstring example (modeling_trocr.py:716-731) still passes pixel_values and is stale.

SamVisionConfig(...) construction did not complete within 60 s in this environment for the DEFAULT config (no JevX code involved, measured by benchmarks/_probe_configs3.py), so no tiny instance could be built inside the sweep time budget. Known-but-unexecuted.
not a key of transformers 5.16.1 CONFIG_MAPPING and has no record in vendor/reports/architecture_inventory.json (709 records scanned).

no `unet` model_type exists in transformers 5.16.1: a scan of all 709 records in vendor/reports/architecture_inventory.json (CONFIG_MAPPING keys + MODEL_* mappings) returns no match, and there is no models/unet/ package under vendor/transformers/src/transformers/models/. The diffusion UNets live under other names (the `mimi`, `xcodec`, `dac` codec stacks), which are waveform decoders with no named pooled output field.other names (e.g. `mimi`, `xcodec`, `dac` codecs) and are not representation backbones with a named pooled output.

no `codegen-audio` model_type exists in transformers 5.16.1 (scanned all 709 records of vendor/reports/architecture_inventory.json); the audio LM analogue is `musicgen` (MusicgenModel, CAUSAL_LM), whose decoder-only LM contract is already covered by the text decoder-only rows of this sweep.

the sub-model configs (gemma3_text/vision, siglip2_*, llava_next_*) are SECONDARY records in the inventory (nested under the composite's text_config/vision_config); the composite families gemma3, siglip2 and llava_next themselves are covered by their own executed rows.
